# clickup_team_available_fields (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (Number) Workspace ID

### Optional

- `include_applied_objects` (Boolean) When `true`, includes `applied_objects` on task-type-scoped Custom Fields in the response.

### Read-Only

- `fields` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Read-Only:

- `applied_objects` (Attributes List) Present only when the Custom Field is scoped to specific custom task types. Lists which task types the field applies to. Omitted for workspace-wide or location-scoped fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--applied_objects))
- `date_created` (String)
- `hide_from_guests` (Boolean)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `type_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--type_config))

<a id="nestedatt--fields--applied_objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.applied_objects`

Read-Only:

- `object_id` (Number) Custom task type ID. Matches `custom_item_id` on tasks. Use [Get Custom Task Types](ref:getcustomitems) to resolve IDs to names.
- `object_type` (Number) Entity type. Use `19` for custom task type.
